technical.summary: Price structure is bullish with long-term uptrend intact and MACD crossover, but weak ADX trend strength, overbought stochRSI, and negative money flow signals limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and no recent news data limit conviction; neutral AAII sentiment (59% bearish) suggests caution.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (416.64), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising dollar pressures multinationals; earnings 99 days out provides minimal near-term event risk but overall environment is highly unfavourable for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with MACD bullish crossover and supertrend confirmation provides technical structure, while extreme fear (21/100) offers contrarian entry opportunity in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar), fundamental conviction is absent (no insider/institutional buying, earnings risk in 99 days), and critical momentum confirmations fail (weak ADX, overbought stochRSI, negative money flow and AO)—technical setup lacks conviction in hostile market regime.
